# WIP libgccjit codegen backend for rust

[![Chat on IRC](https://img.shields.io/badge/irc.libera.chat-%23rustc__codegen__gcc-blue.svg)](https://web.libera.chat/#rustc_codegen_gcc)
[![Chat on Matrix](https://img.shields.io/badge/matrix.org-%23rustc__codegen__gcc-blue.svg)](https://matrix.to/#/#rustc_codegen_gcc:matrix.org)

This is a GCC codegen for rustc, which means it can be loaded by the existing rustc frontend, but benefits from GCC: more architectures are supported and GCC's optimizations

Alive2.llvm_Requirement: Builds against LLVM 22/23 C++ headers with C++20; standalone alive-tv parses LLVM 22.1.x and 23.1.x textual/bitcode IR

Vellvm.llvm_support: VIR AST models opaque pointers (ptr), byte-level poison memory (DTYPE_B), and freeze; differential test driver accepts Clang 14.0.1+ through LLVM 23 textual .ll subset

Lean-MLIR.lean_toolchain: leanprover/lean4:nightly-2025-12-01 (upstream main) / adapted to v4.34.1 for SSA/BitVec dialect definitions
Lean-MLIR.llvm_support: Models MLIR/LLVM integer, poison, and BitVec peephole semantics independent of host libLLVM

rustc-perf.toolchain_support: Benchmarks any rustc binary (>= 1.97.0, including 1.98.1, 1.99.1, 1.100.0, and nightlies) via collector bench_local

abi-cafe.toolchain_support: Invokes arbitrary rustc and C/C++ compilers via CLI; supports all 5 rustc candidates and custom codegen backends (-Zcodegen-backend)

rustlantis.toolchain_support: Emits #[custom_mir] programs (--call-syntax v1..v4); requires RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 on stable (1.98.1, 1.99.1, 1.100.0) or a nightly toolchain
